summary: Spec fidelity (guides): the sample refusal text in canon-gate.md l.318 quotes the old evidence-add message ('Record their answer with `canon brief approve --approver <the human> --note ...` only from that answer'), while the real BRIEF_STOP in evidence.rs:236 now says show, ask, record with --relayed-via and --digest. Documentation drift only; the guide still says nothing that tells an agent to stop and report.
